CreateTlogTask.description_en: Creates a remote log retrieval task for a specified device
CreateTlogTask.description_zh: 创建用户指定设备的远程日志回捞任务

GetError.description_en: Retrieves the details of an error event

GetErrors.description_en: Retrieves the list of all error events under a specific aggregated error
GetErrors.description_zh: 获取某一聚合错误下所有的错误事件列表

GetIssue.description_en: Retrieves the details of an aggregated error

GetTlogCollectList.description_en: Retrieves a list of device log tasks
GetTlogCollectList.description_zh: 获取设备日志任务列表数据

GetTlogDeviceInfo.description_en: Retrieves the details of a device

GetTlogDeviceList.description_en: Queries retrievable devices by device ID, user nickname, user ID, or device attributes
GetTlogDeviceList.description_zh: 按设备ID、用户昵称、用户ID或设备属性查询可回捞设备

GetTlogTaskCollections.description_en: Queries the collection status of each device under a task
GetTlogTaskCollections.description_zh: 查询任务下每台设备的采集状态

GetTlogTaskInfo.description_en: Retrieves the details of a task

RequestUploadToken.description_en: Obtains temporary credentials for uploading symbol tables to OSS
RequestUploadToken.description_zh: 获取上传符号表到OSS的临时凭据

SubmitSymbolic.description_en: Submits the upload result after a symbol table is successfully uploaded to OSS
SubmitSymbolic.description_zh: 符号表成功上传OSS后，提交上传结果
